seo.title: Architecture — A modular, sovereign API platform
seo.description: Inside the Meecrogate architecture: decoupled components (gateway, identity, orchestrator, process executor) deployed on VMs, Kubernetes or the cloud.

title: Technical architecture
subtitle: Cloud-native by design, at home on Kubernetes and on traditional VMs

stateless.title: 100% stateless
stateless.description: No local storage, native horizontal scalability

configurationDriven.title: Configuration-driven
configurationDriven.description: Business logic through JSON files or the graphical interface

monitoring.title: Centralised monitoring
monitoring.description: Logs, metrics and traces built in

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Public cloud plus your own datacenter

gitops.title: GitOps industrialisation process
gitops.footnote: Infrastructure and application are declared, versioned and deployed automatically.
gitops.interactiveHint: Click a component to learn more about it.

station.label: Control Station
station.desc: The administration interface where operators define global configuration visually, low-code. Changes are emitted as JSON and pushed to a Git repository.

git.label: Git repository
git.desc: The single source of truth. Every change is versioned here, which gives you a complete audit trail and instant rollback.

operator.label: Meecrogate Operator
operator.desc: A self-contained Kubernetes controller. It watches the Git repository, detects drift against the state of the cluster, and pulls new configuration securely under a zero-trust model.

config.label: ConfigMap
config.desc: The native Kubernetes object. It holds the synchronised parameters in a dynamic format mounted inside the containers.

pod1.label: Gateway
pod1.desc: The API gateway. It picks up the ConfigMap update and hot-reloads its routing logic in memory, with zero downtime.

pod2.label: ID Server
pod2.desc: The identity server. It issues authentication tokens and refreshes its security policies in real time through the GitOps flow.

pod3.label: Orchestrator
pod3.desc: The service orchestrator. It coordinates internal microservices according to the latest topology, updated on the fly.
